items.title: Decoupled Actor Communication via PubSub
items.description: Universal pattern for event-driven coordination between autonomous agents, CLI wrappers, and UI layers using @dharmax/pubsub.

items.title: Semantika AST+ Semantic Ontology Design
items.description: Rules for defining typed graph entities, bidirectional predicates, and localId resolution with SQLite persistence.

items.title: Service Adapter Pattern for IO and External APIs
items.description: Standardized adapter boundary isolating network, filesystem, and external AI providers behind clean, mockable interfaces.

items.title: Bun Test Suite Execution & Failure Distillation
items.description: Execute targeted test runs using Bun test runner with bail support and compact error extraction.

items.title: Local Stable Diffusion Image Generation
items.description: Generate high-resolution AI images via local Stable Diffusion WebUI API (SDXL on lotus:7860).

items.title: Real-Time Terminal Weather Forecast
items.description: Fetches current weather conditions and forecast for any city, country, or local IP location using wttr.in with clean ANSI styling.

items.title: Git Feature Branch Squash & Linear History
items.description: Squash all commits on a feature branch against the base branch into a single clean conventional commit without detached HEAD states.

items.title: Safe POSIX Port Isolation & Process Termination
items.description: Locate process occupying a network port via lsof/ss, identify owner/binary, and perform safe progressive SIGTERM/SIGKILL termination.

items.title: Autonomous Skill Authoring & Packaging Meta-Skill
items.description: Inspects host environment, audits local topology/services, scaffolds a standardized skill bundle (skill.json, run.ts, test.ts), runs a verification test, and registers it into the local AI runtime.
